result.reason: The clause covers Affiliates and contractors, but does not make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable, restrict termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach, or permit transfer to successors. It also fails the fallback because Affiliate coverage is not conditioned on written notice and no M&A-successor transfer right is included. Deleting “solely” unnecessarily broadens the use restriction, and allowing revocation upon any termination or expiration does not meet the required termination standard.
